sources.quote: Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The re-audit approves Chisone as a company only. Part approvals are separate and unchanged. No controlled record in the documents covers SUP-C for BR-225 at any receiving plant or customer. The documents do not name the customer of BR-225 either, so the key's customer part is unknown. Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so a person must confirm whether a part release exists for SUP-C, BR-225, the receiving plant and the customer.
